name: moderation
title: Moderation
summary: People report content and other users, block anyone, and staff work a review queue; text is filtered before it is posted, and posts and comments are screened by rules and an optional decision model that can hold them for review.

env.name: MODERATION_BLOCKED_TERMS
env.doc: Comma-separated words or phrases refused before posting; matching ignores case, accents and common letter swaps (h3llo).

env.name: MODERATION_PROVIDER
env.doc: Extra AI check before posting: none or openai. A provider outage lets text through and logs the error.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.doc: OpenAI API key; required when MODERATION_PROVIDER=openai (the moderation endpoint is free).

env.name: MODERATION_AUTOHIDE_REPORTS
env.doc: Hide content once this many different people report it, until staff review it; 0 turns auto-hide off.

env.name: MODERATION_NOTIFY_REPORTER
env.doc: Tell reporters when staff close their report (generic wording, no details about the action).

env.name: MODERATION_LINK_DENYLIST
env.doc: Comma-separated domains whose links are removed by screening (subdomains included).

env.name: MODERATION_BRAND_DOMAINS
env.doc: Comma-separated domains that are the app's own besides PUBLIC_WEB_URL's; links to look-alikes of them are removed or held.

env.name: MODERATION_STRIKE_LIMITS
env.doc: Strikes within 90 days that stop someone posting, and for how long from their latest strike (strikes:duration, comma-separated); off turns posting restrictions off.

env.name: MODERATION_DECISION_URL
env.doc: Decision model endpoint speaking the decisions format (state + yes/no questions), e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions. Unset = rules only.

env.name: MODERATION_DECISION_API_KEY
env.doc: Bearer key for MODERATION_DECISION_URL; required when it is set.

env.name: MODERATION_DECISION_MODEL
env.doc: Model id sent with each decision request (e.g. typesafe/jev-1.13); the answering snapshot is recorded on each decision.

env.name: MODERATION_DECISION_MAX_RPS
env.doc: Decision requests per second at most; an item that can't get a slot within half the timeout keeps the rules' decision.

env.name: MODERATION_DECISION_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Time limit per decision request (posting waits for it); on timeout the rules' decision stands.

env.name: MODERATION_DECISION_DAILY_USD
env.doc: Most the decision model may cost per UTC day, per server instance, in dollars; 0 = no cap. Past it, rules only until midnight UTC.

stitch: Write the community rules the filter and the queue enforce, link them from the Terms, and put the reasons in your own words if needed.
Decide MODERATION_AUTOHIDE_REPORTS for launch (3 is a common start for a public feed; 0 for small private groups).
Name who works the queue and how they hear about new cases (admin:live is realtime; add an email or chat alert if nobody watches the console). Target: every case closed within 24 hours.
Fill MODERATION_BLOCKED_TERMS for your audience and language; set MODERATION_PROVIDER=openai for public UGC.

Screening: set MODERATION_BRAND_DOMAINS (your other domains), MODERATION_LINK_DENYLIST and MODERATION_STRIKE_LIMITS; optionally MODERATION_DECISION_URL, _API_KEY and _MODEL for the decision model (name the service in the privacy policy), and watch Admin → Moderation for its health and cost.
Add ReportDialog/BlockButton (web and mobile src/features/moderation) wherever a person or their content appears that no feature already covers (profiles, avatars, member lists).
